name: Edinburgh, Parliament Square
description: A car park on the Royal Mile, surrounded by some of Scotland's most protected buildings.

terrain.encoding: float32le, row-major, rows run +z (north to south), columns run +x (west to east)

factors.label: Neighbours close to the boundary
factors.detail: 3 building(s) within 6 m of the boundary, the nearest 2.0 m away. Needs careful excavation, scaffolding and demolition.

factors.label: Sloping site
factors.detail: Falls about 10% to the north, 5.0 m across the plot. Expect cut and fill, retaining walls or stepped foundations.

factors.label: Road or path crosses the plot
factors.detail: Crossed by High Street, Lawnmarket, St Giles' Street, service, footway. It must be diverted or kept open.

factors.label: Protected neighbours
factors.detail: 2 listed or historic feature(s) within 25 m. Vibration and damage limits apply during build and demolition.

factors.label: Made ground
factors.detail: Previously developed land: buried foundations, fill and possible contamination. Trial pits recommended.
